name: Black Rosary
source:
Petro is a young man who looks to the future with courage, but guilt, pain and regrets over the death of his friend keep him awake every night. He goes to sleep listening to the echo of the waking city, but thoughts about his friend do not leave Petro even in his dreams.

[From [url=https://smg-82.itch.io/black-rosary]itch.io[/url]]
